why.heading: Why IP research needs better tools
why.scatteredBody: Relevant IP information is spread across statutes, registries, standards and knowledge sources.
why.complexBody: Patent, traditional knowledge, formulation and ABS questions often require multiple sources.
why.languageBody: Important information is not always accessible in the user's preferred language.
why.traceBody: AI answers need clear evidence and authoritative sources.

capabilities.heading: One workspace for complex IP research
capabilities.tkBody: Identify traditional-knowledge indicators and related evidence.
capabilities.formulationBody: Organize ingredients, formulation type and relevant IP considerations.
capabilities.absBody: Identify potential relevance of biological-resource access and benefit-sharing requirements.
capabilities.lawBody: Research relevant Acts, Rules and legal provisions.
capabilities.multiBody: Support multilingual interaction while keeping application UI language separate from AI input and output language.

how.heading: How Sahayak works
how.step1Body: Describe your invention, formulation or IP question.
how.step2Body: Sahayak identifies language, jurisdiction, IP type and relevant research areas.
how.step3Body: Relevant legal, patent, traditional knowledge and regulatory sources are searched.
how.step4Body: Evidence is ranked, citations are verified and the result is presented with supporting sources.

investigation.heading: See the research behind the answer
investigation.body: Sahayak makes its research process visible so users can understand which areas were considered and which sources contributed to an answer.
investigation.title: AI Investigation
investigation.exampleNote: Visual example of research metadata. This is not a live result.
investigation.trailHint: Safe execution metadata only. Hidden model reasoning is not shown.

evidence.heading: From AI answers to evidence-backed research
evidence.exampleNote: Visual example of an evidence card. Not a live citation.
evidence.whyBody: Users can trace important information back to authoritative sources.

architecture.heading: Built for grounded IP research
architecture.sources: Legal RAG + patent search + TK / ABS

demo.body: Explore how a question moves from research intent to an evidence-backed answer.
demo.label: Product walkthrough

useCases.heading: Designed for real IP research workflows
useCases.patentBody: Explore relevant patent records and evidence.
useCases.formulationBody: Analyze formulation ingredients and potential IP areas.
useCases.tkBody: Identify traditional-use indicators and related sources.
useCases.lawBody: Understand relevant Acts, Rules and provisions.
useCases.note: These workflows support research. They do not imply definitive legal conclusions.

multilingual.heading: Research across languages
multilingual.body: Sahayak is designed to support multilingual interaction using language technologies and national language infrastructure such as Bhashini.
multilingual.bhashini: Designed to leverage language infrastructure such as Bhashini. This integration is not live yet.
multilingual.selectorNote: The global language selector controls only the application UI. It does not control AI input language, AI response language, voice input language, or AI translation behavior.

trust.heading: Built around evidence and responsible use
trust.sourceBody: Answers are grounded in curated authoritative sources.
trust.traceBody: Important information can be connected to supporting evidence.
trust.safeBody: When evidence is insufficient, Sahayak can recommend further review rather than presenting unsupported conclusions.
trust.humanBody: Users can request review from an IP facilitator.

review.body: When a question requires professional assessment, users can request human IP facilitator review.

final.heading: Start your IP research with Sahayak.
final.body: Ask a question, explore the evidence and understand where your research needs a closer look.
